Schließlich or Endlich? German B2 Adverb Practice

Compare endlich for an awaited outcome with schließlich for a final sequence point or an after-all reason. Practise context and speaker attitude.

B2 level4 worked examples4 practice questions + writing task

Independent practice by Klarweg. Not an official Goethe exam or assessment.

Try the exercisesWrite your own sentence

Understand the difference

Endlich often expresses relief or impatience when an awaited event occurs: Endlich ist der Handwerker da! Schließlich can introduce a final stage in a sequence or mean after all when justifying a statement. Both can describe something happening at the end, but their focus and speaker attitude can differ.

Common mistake to avoid

Do not give schließlich just one translation. It can mean finally in a sequence and after all in a justification; endlich often adds an awaited-outcome perspective.

How to practise: read the examples once, cover the English meanings and try explaining the choice aloud. Next, complete all four questions before opening their answers.

Four German examples with English meanings

Compare the meaning and sentence pattern, rather than choosing by English translation alone.

Worked example 1Endlich ist der Handwerker da; wir haben lange gewartet.At last the tradesperson is here; we waited a long time.
Worked example 2Ich vertraue ihr; schließlich kennt sie das Projekt genau.I trust her; after all, she knows the project well.
Worked example 3Nach mehreren Umwegen erreichten wir schließlich die Hütte.After several detours we eventually reached the hut.
Worked example 4Endlich habe ich den schwierigen Knoten gelöst!At last I have untied the difficult knot!

Practice: choose the right word

Choose endlich for the explicitly relieved at-last meaning and schließlich for the explicit after-all justification. Try each question before opening the answer. Where another answer is possible, the explanation notes it. These are self-check exercises, not exam scoring.

Question 1. ___ hat der Regen aufgehört! Darauf haben wir sehnsüchtig gewartet. (at last)

Show answer and explanation for question 1

Answer: Endlich

The cue explicitly expresses relief after waiting.

Question 2. Wir sollten ihn fragen; ___ hat er die Anlage gebaut. (after all)

Show answer and explanation for question 2

Answer: schließlich

Schließlich supplies a reason supporting the suggestion.

Question 3. ___ sind die Reparaturen fertig! Was für eine Erleichterung. (at last)

Show answer and explanation for question 3

Answer: Endlich

Endlich highlights the eagerly awaited completion.

Question 4. Sie darf mitentscheiden; ___ ist sie Teil des Teams. (after all)

Show answer and explanation for question 4

Answer: schließlich

Schließlich justifies why she should be included.

Use it in your own sentence

Express relief that a bus has arrived, then give an after-all justification.

Try writing your answer before reading the model below. Other natural answers are possible.

One possible answer

Endlich kommt der Bus! Schließlich warten wir seit einer Stunde.

Check your wording: Endlich conveys the waiting speaker's relief; schließlich introduces the justification.

What to practise next

Write a new context for each word. Explain which meaning or object pattern makes your choice natural; some contexts allow both.

Try the gaps again on another day without reading the explanation first. If a choice is still unclear, use the linked grammar foundation before moving to another topic.
